composition_subtypes.role: Preprocess: sort descending and deduplicate to enable greedy selection.
Recursive greedy selection with alternative start to explore subsets.

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorts distinct numbers descending, then recursive greedy selection with backtracking via alternate starting point to maximize sum of up to three non-divisible numbers.
payload.rationale: Sorting is essential for largest-first greedy logic; recursive calls with and without the first element approximate a limited backtracking search.
